name: Sellerise
description:
Sellerise brings your Amazon business data into Claude - clear, structured, and ready to analyze.

Connect your Sellerise account to ask questions about sales, profit, advertising, inventory, keyword rankings, Amazon Search Query Performance, reviews, reimbursements, payouts, Subscribe & Save, and overall account performance.

Get fast answers without digging through dashboards: compare periods, spot profit leaks, find inefficient ad spend, identify stock risks, and see which products, campaigns, keywords, or search terms need attention.

Use it to understand what changed, what is driving performance, and where your Amazon business may be losing money or missing opportunities.

Sellerise uses read-only access to your Amazon business data, so you can analyze performance and make better-informed decisions without modifying your account. Sellerise is Amazon ToS-compliant, helping you analyze and understand your business while staying aligned with Amazon’s rules.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Sellerise to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Sellerise to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.sellerise.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Sellerise MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sellerise lists 20 MCP tools, including analyze_sales_change, get_account_metrics, get_ads_search_term_insights, get_ads_targeting_insights, get_alert_summary, get_inventory_risks, get_keyword_sqp_insights, get_keyword_tracker_insights, get_manual_adjustment_insights, get_order_info, get_payout_insights, and get_ppc_efficiency.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Sellerise?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Sellerise in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Sellerise requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Sellerise is developed by Sellerise Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
